experiment.radial_phase_convention: physical p->s/p->d values are (1,-1) after i^lprime; even lprime makes Chinook (-i)^lprime and DiffPES (+i)^lprime identical

conventions.kpoints: Cartesian inverse angstrom in the sample frame
conventions.eigenvectors: ket coefficients; Chinook columns are transposed to DiffPES band-major rows
conventions.chinook_real_harmonic_reconciliation: evaluate Chinook at (epsilon_x,-epsilon_y,epsilon_z); this reconciles its sine-harmonic y sign with the canonical DiffPES Cartesian convention
conventions.final_momentum: vacuum momentum with in-plane component equal to initial momentum and positive outgoing z
conventions.site_phase: DiffPES uses exp(i*(k_i-k_f).R_o); the raw Chinook comparator has no orbital-centre final-state phase
conventions.normalization: raw amplitudes and intensities; no fitted scale or post-hoc normalization
